description: Polymer web component behavior for button state management, including properties, event handlers, and behaviors related to toggle and pressed states.

classes.name: Polymer.IronButtonStateImpl
classes.description: Behavior object defining properties, event handlers, and logic for button states in Polymer components.

methods.name: _tapHandler
methods.description: Handles tap events to toggle active state if toggles property is true.

methods.name: _detectKeyboardFocus
methods.description: Detects if the element received focus via keyboard.

methods.name: _userActivate
methods.description: Sets the active state and fires change event, emulating native checkbox behavior.

methods.name: _downHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer down events, updating pointerDown and pressed states.

methods.name: _upHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer up events, resetting pressed state.

methods.name: __isFocusedLightDescendant
methods.description: Checks if a target element is a focused descendant light element.

methods.name: _spaceKeyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles spacebar keydown to emulate button press.

methods.name: _spaceKeyUpHandler
methods.description: Handles spacebar keyup to trigger click if pressed.

methods.name: _pressedChanged
methods.description: Responds to changes in pressed property.

methods.name: _activeChanged
methods.description: Updates ARIA attribute and button state when active property changes.

methods.name: _controlStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in control state, e.g., disabled.

methods.name: _changedButtonState
methods.description: Hook for subclasses or behaviors to react to button state changes.
